title: Strategic AI Translator
description:
In het kort
Within the Mortgages Data Domain, we use Data & AI to fundamentally improve how clients and employees experience our services. We are accelerating the transition towards a truly data‑ and AI‑driven organization, where insights are available at every critical moment in the mortgage journey.
As a
Domain Expert (Data & AI)
, you operate at the intersection of business, data, and strategy. You identify high-value opportunities, shape compelling AI use cases, and translate complex challenges into scalable solutions. You bring a consulting mindset—structuring ambiguity, building strong cases, and driving measurable impact end-to-end.
Je werk
You combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery and are responsible for driving high-impact Data & AI initiatives across ABN AMRO Mortgages.
You will:
Identify and prioritize high-impact AI use cases, translating business challenges into actionable Data & AI solutions
Build strong, structured business cases (problem framing, value drivers, ROI, risks)
Lead the structuring and delivery of initiatives, ensuring focus on what truly drives impact
Collaborate closely with senior stakeholders, Product Owners, and data teams to drive execution end-to-end
Act as a trusted advisor, confidently challenging and guiding decision-making
Act as the go-to AI-expert within the data domain, inspiring teams and elevating AI literacy
Drive and shape the broader AI strategy and roadmap
You bring clarity where others see complexity and move seamlessly between strategic discussions and execution.
Werkomgeving
You will join a team of domain experts and collaborate with colleagues from across the organisation—no two days will be the same. The Data Domain Mortgages is part of the Chief Data and technology Officer organisation within ABN AMRO Mortgages. As a Domain Expert, you play a key role in shaping our future data landscape and in developing new AI & Analytics solutions that support both customers and employees.
Key stakeholders span across Chief Operations & Distribution (CODO), the Chief Data & Technology Office (CDTO), the AI community, and senior management.
Je profiel
You are a seasoned professional with a strong consulting background and a proven ability to turn complexity into results.
Ideal experience:
Master’s degree (WO) and min 5 years of experience, ideally in top-tier consulting or similar environments
Proven experience in (Gen)AI, data platforms, and analytics
Strong trackrecord in structuring complex problems, building business cases, and influencing senior decision-making
Experience driving Data & AI use case development from concept to implementation
Proven ability to manage and influence stakeholders at senior (MT/ExCo) level
Strong analytical skills combined with excellent communication and storytelling
Fluent in English and comfortable working in Dutch
Other personal characteristics
Highly execution-driven, with a strong focus on delivering tangible results
Strategic thinker with the ability to define clear direction in ambiguous environments
Natural relationship builder who fosters collaboration across teams and functions
Wij bieden
We offer a high-impact role where you shape the future of Data & AI within Mortgages. You will work in an ambitious environment with real decision-making influence, where your ideas translate into tangible results.
In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
Interesse?
Does this sound like something you’d be interested in? Send us your application as soon as possible, we are looking forward to meet you.

title: Data Scientist - Transaction Banking Data Domain
description:
At a glance
Are you an experienced Data Scientist with an interest in the financial sector and banking products? Would you like to work in a team of motivated data professionals that supports strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making through data-driven insights? If so, the Transaction Banking Data Domain could be a great place to further develop your skills and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
Your job
As a Data Scientist, you will:
Develop innovative Analytics & AI solutions using Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AI Agents.
Turn business challenges into actionable data-driven insights and recommendations.
Lead projects from idea to implementation, working closely with business and technical teams.
Explore large and diverse datasets to identify opportunities, trends, and performance improvements.
Advise stakeholders on KPIs, reporting, and decision-making through compelling data storytelling.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, Architects, and business experts to deliver impact.
Drive automation, continuous improvement, and adoption of data-driven ways of working.
Stay at the forefront of developments in AI, GenAI, cloud technologies, and advanced analytics.
Working environment
The Advanced Analytics & AI Center of Expertise (AA&AI CoE) is part of the Transaction Banking Data Domain, helping drive excellence through data. We support a broad portfolio of banking products and use advanced analytics, AI, and GenAI to generate insights, improve processes, optimize performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business.
Our team acts as both trusted advisors and change agents, helping embed a data-driven mindset throughout the organization. We work closely with business experts, product owners, and leaders to solve complex challenges and create customer value.
The Transaction Banking Data Domain consists of 40+ professionals across the Netherlands and India. We offer a collaborative, agile, and inclusive environment where ownership, continuous learning, innovation, and celebrating success are part of our culture, guided by the bank's values of Care, Collaboration, and Courage.
Your profile
Do you think you are a fit? Check your qualifications:
Degree in STEM or economics/business, with an analytics focus.
6-8 years of work experience, with at least 3 years in data science field.
Exhibit high level of proficiency in programming languages such as Python, PySpark, SQL and coding best practices.
Experience with Machine Learning and AI (Forecasting, Prediction, Cluster Analysis, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Document processing, AI Agents), and eagerness to learn and develop in that area.
A combination of analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, communication, and reporting skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English (and Dutch)
Great to have:
Knowledge of the financial sector and/or banking products.
Experience in working on azure/ Databricks/ or similar cloud platforms.
Affinity towards technical topics including data and machine learning engineering.
Microsoft DP-100 certification (Azure Data Scientist Associate).
Knowledge of agile methodology, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Microsoft AZ-900 certification (basic knowledge of Azure cloud services).
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.
In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.

Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.

Collective Labour Agreement (CLA)
, which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
Does this sound like your next career move? Then apply! We look forward to meeting you.

Banking for better, for generations to come.

title: Business Consultant - FEC Data Domain (DFC)

Based on our purpose 'Banking for better, for generations to come', we are committed to a sustainable, stable and secure financial system. Detecting financial crime is therefore high on our agenda. The Financial Economic Crime (FEC) Data Domain is responsible for enabling & accelerating DFC processes through high quality Data Products. We work on data onboarding, data modelling, data quality to translate data towards business value. Our aim is to work towards a centralized, rationalized, high quality data landscape to facilitate the wide range of DFC processes.

As a Business Consultant in the Data Product Team within the FEC Data Domain, you will play a pivotal role in delivering end-to-end data solutions to generate value for DFC and data consumers across the organization. We are looking for someone who can combine data management expertise with curiosity, analytical thinking and strong communication skills. The role requires a person who is comfortable diving into details, understanding complex data landscapes, asking critical questions and helping bridge the gap between business and technology.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Understanding the data needs and related requirements of new regulatory requirements and build Data Products to meet those.

Experience with Databricks or equivalent is a plus.
Basic understanding of Data Management principles is a plus.
You demonstrate “data savviness” and are capable of performing queries and analyzing data independently.

You embrace the Agile way of working and are comfortable with the Scrum methodology.

title: Medior Data Analyst & Engineer (DFC)
description:
In het kort
Wil jij werk doen dat ertoe doet? Samen met een team van ervaren data-experts werk je aan dataproducten die helpen bij cruciale beslissingen binnen de bank en bijdragen aan het opsporen en voorkomen van financiële criminaliteit. Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Lees dan verder!
Je werk
Als Medior Data Analyst & Engineer binnen Planning & Release Management (PRM) werk je dagelijks aan het verbeteren, bouwen en opschalen van essentiële dataproducten. Je maakt dus impact op een complexe IT-keten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat data betrouwbaar, van hoge kwaliteit en direct bruikbaar is voor besluitvorming.
Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van business en IT en vertaalt vragen uit de business naar slimme, toekomstbestendige data‑oplossingen. Dat doe je samen met een gedreven team waarin kennis delen, samenwerken en elkaar uitdagen centraal staan.
Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert het PRM‑platform in PySpark, met focus op performance, schaalbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid.
Je ontsluit nieuwe databronnen en maakt deze structureel beschikbaar voor het team.
Je werkt continu aan datakwaliteit en data‑integriteit van het datamodel.
Je pakt ownership over grotere werkpakketten en epics: van planning en prioritering tot uitvoering van ontwikkelwerk.
Je voert ad‑hoc analyses uit over de volledige keten en denkt proactief mee over verbeterinitiatieven.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen én buiten jouw focusgebied en zorgt voor heldere communicatie.
Werkomgeving
De wereld verandert snel en daarmee ook onze rol als gatekeeper. Binnen Detecting Financial Crime lopen we voorop in het voorkomen en bestrijden van financiële criminaliteit. Dat doen we met slimme data-oplossingen, vernieuwende ideeën en een sterke focus op samenwerking.
Bij Planning & Release Management (P&RM) werk je in een data-gedreven team waar impact maken centraal staat. Vanuit de domeinen Future State, Data, Populatie, Planning, Release en Analyse zorgen we voor inzicht, regie en continue verbetering binnen de DFC-keten. Hier krijg je de kans om jouw expertise in te zetten én verder te ontwikkelen, terwijl je samenwerkt met gedreven professionals uit verschillende disciplines.
Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen die collega's helpen hun werk slimmer en voorspelbaarder uit te voeren. Daarbij krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en volop mogelijkheden om te groeien. We combineren het beste van twee werelden: twee dagen samen op kantoor in Amersfoort voor verbinding en samenwerking, en de vrijheid om de overige dagen te werken waar jij het beste tot je recht komt.
Je profiel
Of jouw achtergrond en ervaring nu ligt in data-analyse, engineering of business analyse, voor ons is vooral belangrijk dat jij:
Een afgeronde HBO, WO of PhD opleiding hebt in een technische of kwantitatieve richting.
Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring op zak hebt.
Ervaring met Python hebt via studie, stage, minor of werkervaring (ervaring met PySpark en Databricks is een pré).
Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.
Beschikt over een sterke analytische en data‑gedreven mindset.
Ervaring met Advanced Analytics, Agile/Scrum en Power BI zien we als een mooie pré, maar is geen vereiste. Nieuwsgierigheid, lerend vermogen en een inhoudelijke drive zien we als minstens zo belangrijk.

Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.
Daarnaast bieden wij:
Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.

Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar,dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privégebruik.

title: Graduation Internship | Damage localization of a vessel using iFEM and deep learning
description:
About this position
Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) is a continuous process of damage identification strategies and can be used for condition monitoring of a navy vessel. Knowing the structural condition of a navy vessel is important to maximize the operability of the vessel. For vessels, damage prognostics after an extreme event like a blast is even important but significantly more complex. Recently Inverse FEM combined with AI techniques has emerged as a potential technology to help with this and be able to identify, localize and assess the damage after any extreme military threat. Inverse Finite Element Method (iFEM) is a shape and stress-sensing technique to reconstruct the displacement field using a limited number of sensors. To apply this approach, iFEM combined with an AI model needs to be developed, trained and validated. This work will be done in collaboration with and under the guidance of TNO Naval and Offshore Structure Department. There is also the possibility of combining this with an internship.
What will be your role?
During this graduation internship, you will investigate and develop how structural damage can be localized after an extreme accidental load. You will develop iFEM tooling to reconstruct displacement and stress/strain fields for loading condition and geometry. Developing and validating a Deep Neural Network or other machine learning method to identify the damage locations. You will combine literature research with calculations and numerical analyses, using tools such as Python and finite element software.
Your task will include:
Implemented iFEM tool for navy applications be able to reconstruct displacement and stress/strain fields for a loading condition for a given geometry.
Developing Deep Neural Network (DNN) or another machine learning method to identify the damage location.
Validating the developed tooling.
Potentially, identify the limitations of iFEM for SHM considering noise.
Potentially, developing tool to assess remain strength.
Through your work, you will contribute to a larger development of investigating how monitoring implemented can improve operations, support long-term ambition of decision-making SHM for Maritime and offshore structures. You will learn how to implement and improve state-of-the-art technology for maritime and offshore applications and how to adopt technology from other fields into the maritime domain.
What we expect from you
We are looking for a student with a background in maritime engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, aerospace engineering or a similar technical degree. You have an interest in ship structures, numerical simulations and artificial intelligence. You are curious and able to work independently within a multidisciplinary environment.
Desired experience:
Experience with finite element modelling (e.g. Abaqus, Ansys or similar software).
Experience or knowledge in developing and validating ML techniques.
Knowledge of strength of materials, structural mechanics and dynamics.
Basic programming skills (Python).
You are in the final stage of your degree in civil engineering, marine engineering or aerospace engineering (or a similar degree).
What you'll get in return
An internship at TNO means working in an environment where substance and impact are central. You will become part of a knowledge organisation where research and practice come together, and where experts collaborate on solutions to current societal and technological challenges.
Your internship is a period in which you can discover what suits you, where your strengths lie and what you would like to learn next. You are part of a professional working environment, gain insight into how things work in practice, and have the opportunity to build experience that goes beyond this internship alone. For many students, an internship is therefore also a first step in discovering whether TNO could be a potential next step after graduation.
In addition, we offer you:

title: Medior Scientist Underwater Communications
description:
About this position
In today’s unpredictable geopolitical climate, safeguarding our society is crucial. TNO, as a knowledge institute, plays a vital role in the ecosystem with about a thousand highly educated employees specialising in innovations for Defence & Security. Here, you can actively contribute to a safer world, both nationally and at a European level.
The Acoustics and Underwater Warfare division brings together all acoustic expertise within TNO and primarily works for the Royal Navy. The Underwater Operations & Seabed Security department focuses on research and development in the field of autonomous underwater systems. Applications include detecting sea mines with autonomous underwater and surface drones, 'stand-off' submarine combat, wireless underwater (network) communication, or protecting critical infrastructure on the seabed. We develop state-of-the-art acoustic sensor systems, including advanced data processing algorithms for communication, visualisation and information extraction to generate situational awareness.
What will be your role?
As a medior scientist in underwater communications, you will work on multiple projects to develop innovative solutions for our clients, often including the Ministry of Defence. Each project has its own team with whom you work closely, and because no project is ever the same, you will have plenty of opportunities to develop further.
Depending on your background and preferences, you may be involved with:
Improving algorithms for acoustic and optical underwater communications on various layers of the OSI model.
Research into optimising communications within networks of autonomous (underwater) nodes and drones.
Designing, setting up, and carrying out experiments, both through realistic simulations and measurements in the laboratory or at sea.
Reporting and presenting results to Defence, peers, and colleagues.
